paper_title: An Electron Acceptor with Broad Visible-NIR Absorption and Unique Solid State Packing for As-Cast High Performance Binary Organic Solar Cells
source_file: /home/wzfeng/MySearch/PhotoRag/MD/Adv Funct Materials - 2018 - Shi - An Electron Acceptor with Broad Visible NIR Absorption and Unique Solid State Packing/auto/Adv Funct Materials - 2018 - Shi - An Electron Acceptor with Broad Visible NIR Absorption and Unique Solid State Packing.md

knowledge_points.content: 6TIC-4F is an A-D-A type electron acceptor designed with a strongly electron-donating terthieno[3,2-b]thiophene (6T) core and two flanking electron-withdrawing 2-(5,6-difluoro-3-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1H-inden-1-ylidene)malononitrile (IC-2F) units.
knowledge_points.evidence: Herein, we report a novel low bandgap acceptor 6TIC-4F with a strongly electron-donating core unit terthieno[3,2-b] thiophene (6T) and two flanking strongly electron-withdrawing acceptor units 2-(5,6-difluoro-3-oxo-2,3-dihydro-1Hinden-1-ylidene)malononitrile (IC-2F)

knowledge_points.content: Binary organic solar cells using as-cast PBDB-T:6TIC-4F blends achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 11.14% with a short-circuit current (JSC) of 23.00 mA cm⁻², an open-circuit voltage (VOC) of 0.723 V, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.67.
knowledge_points.evidence: The as-cast solar cells based on ... (PBDB-T):6TIC-4F exhibit a high PCE of 11.14% and a high JSC of 23.00 mA cm-2 and a fill factor (FF) of 0.67

knowledge_points.content: Extending the fused-ring core from 4T (in 4TIC-4F) to 6T (in 6TIC-4F) results in a redshifted absorption edge from approximately 940 nm to 1000 nm and a reduction in the optical bandgap to 1.24 eV.
knowledge_points.evidence: In solid-state, the absorption of 6TIC-4F further redshifted to ≈1000 nm, while 4TIC-4F had an absorption edge at ≈940 nm... 6TIC-4F with terthieno[3,2-b]thiophene (6T) as the core unit... exhibits an extraordinarily narrow bandgap (≈1.24 eV)

knowledge_points.content: The 6TIC-4F molecule maintains a rigid, isomer-free geometry due to intramolecular [S...O] interactions between the terminal IC-2F groups and the central 6T core.
knowledge_points.evidence: The high rigidity of 6TIC-4F benefits from the unique interaction between the terminal IC-2F group and the central 6T group, with terminal IC-2F units and central 6T unit interlocked via the intimate [S...O] interactions... which also ensures an isomer-free molecular geometry.

knowledge_points.content: X-ray crystallographic analysis of 6TIC-4F reveals close intermolecular π-π stacking distances of 3.522 Å between adjacent IC-2F groups and 3.359 Å between IC-2F and the outmost thieno[3,2-b]thiophene (TT) units.
knowledge_points.evidence: the adjacent IC-2F groups can form a close intermolecular π-π stacking with a distance of ≈3.522 Å: the IC-2F units can also interact with adjacent outmost TT unit of 6T via π-π interaction (distance: ≈3.359 Å).

knowledge_points.content: The PBDB-T:6TIC-4F device exhibits a relatively low VOC loss of 0.517 V, calculated as the difference between the optical bandgap (Eg) and the open-circuit voltage (VOC).
knowledge_points.evidence: Another particularly noteworthy is its relatively low VOC loss of 0.517 V (VOC loss = eEg^OPT - VOC).

knowledge_points.content: 6TIC-4F exhibits higher electron mobility (4.52 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹) compared to 4TIC-4F (2.23 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹), which is attributed to the more ordered packing motif observed in its solid state.
knowledge_points.evidence: The hole and electron mobility ... were estimated to be ... 2.23 × 10-4 cm2 V-1 s-1 for 4TIC-4F and ... 4.52 × 10-4 cm2 V-1 s-1 for 6TIC-4F... The higher mobility of 6TIC-4F is attributed to the unique ordered packing motif observed in its solid-state.

knowledge_points.content: High performance in PBDB-T:6TIC-4F devices is achieved in the as-cast state, meaning no solvent additives or post-treatments like thermal annealing are required to reach the peak PCE of 11.14%.
knowledge_points.evidence: It was found that further treatments with solvent additives and thermal annealing do not enhance the overall efficiency... OSC devices of PBDB-T:6TIC-4F without any solvent additive or post-treatment exhibit a high PCE of 11.14%

knowledge_points.content: The light intensity-dependent JSC measurement for 6TIC-4F devices yielded an alpha (α) value of 0.974, indicating minimal charge recombination loss during extraction.
knowledge_points.evidence: The JSC for device based on 6TIC-4F exhibits an index of 0.974 with the light intensity... The close to unity light intensity dependence (α value) in 6TIC-4F device indicates less charge recombination loss

knowledge_points.content: Resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSOXS) at 285 eV revealed a center-to-center phase separation distance of 60 nm in the PBDB-T:6TIC-4F blend.
knowledge_points.evidence: Blended thin film phase separation was investigated using resonant soft X-ray scattering (RSOXS) using 285 eV photon energy. A more pronounced scattering hump feature was seen at around 0.011 Å-1 giving a center-to-center distance of 60 nm.
